# GoldAlert

GoldAlert (goldalert.org) is a free, educational multi-asset dashboard covering spot gold, spot silver, gold-mining shares, gold and silver ETFs, gold-backed cryptoassets, commodities (WTI crude oil, natural gas, copper, platinum), and broad crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum).

Core signal rule:
- 0–2 consecutive lower daily closes: HOLD
- 3–4 consecutive lower daily closes: 50% BUY / WATCH
- 5 or more consecutive lower daily closes: 100% BUY / STRONG

The percentage labels are rule stages, not probabilities, guarantees, or individualized position-size recommendations.

Assets tracked: spot gold (XAU/USD), spot silver (XAG/USD), AngloGold Ashanti (NYSE:AU), Kinross Gold (NYSE:KGC), Harmony Gold (NYSE:HMY), Gold Fields (NYSE:GFI), VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX), SPDR Gold Shares (GLD), iShares Silver Trust (SLV), Pax Gold (PAXG), Tether Gold (XAUT), WTI Crude Oil (CL=F), Natural Gas (NG=F), Copper (HG=F), Platinum (PL=F), Bitcoin (BTC-USD), Ethereum (ETH-USD).

Cross-Asset Ratios tracked: Gold/Silver ratio, Gold/Miners ratio, PAXG spot premium, Gold/Oil ratio, Gold/Bitcoin ratio, Gold/Platinum ratio.
